description: This file defines a static utility class 'RandomUtilities' used for generating random values, symbols, and GrainIds for testing purposes within the Orleans framework. It includes constants for grain type codes, a dictionary of random generators for various types, and methods to retrieve random values, symbols, and GrainIds based on type parameters.

classes.name: RandomUtilities
classes.description: A static class providing methods to generate random values, symbols, and GrainIds for testing within Orleans framework.

methods.name: GetRandom
methods.description: Returns a random value of the specified type T, optionally within a given range.

methods.name: GetRandomCharacters
methods.description: Generates a string of random characters from a specified symbol set and count.

methods.name: GetRandomGrainId
methods.description: Generates a random GrainId for a given key type and optional key extension.
